policy.reference: all caller points from original initial; independent full-state fixed-step RK4
policy.stress_scale: max(1 Pa,Frobenius original supplied stress), fixed per case
policy.reference_uncertainty: max finest-minus-middle and middle-minus-coarse, observed only; no rigorous bound
policy.reference_shrink: finest-middle <= .35*(middle-coarse) unless both below roundoff floor
policy.caller_partition_shrink: tight endpoint n1/n7 discrepancy <= .35*loose + 2*roundoff floor; no reference uncertainty term
policy.compiled_refinement: each successor <= .65*predecessor and tight <= .35*loose, each plus 2*(roundoff floor + observed reference uncertainty)
policy.support: every RK4 stage and returned state must pass the independent source domain; no clipping/projection

covariance.caveat: rounded rotated initial/loading define slightly different exact binary64 inputs; empirical covariance check
